title: Robust Learning Meets Quasar-Convex Optimization: Inexact High-Order Proximal-Point Methods
summary: Robust learning aims to maintain model performance under noise, corruption, and distributional shifts, which are prevalent in modern machine learning applications. This work shows that examples of robust learning problems can be formulated as (strongly) quasar-convex optimization problems, which admit a benign landscape with no saddle points. We then propose HiPPA, an inexact high-order proximal-point method that employs a model-value gap to control the inexactness of subproblem solutions.
